description.value: Small oceanside RV park in Sayward with Pacific Ocean and mountain views, a free boat launch, firewood, and coin-op hot showers. All six sites are full-hookup oceanfront; it caters primarily to RVs, but the wildlife-rich setting and village amenities make it a worthwhile overnight for cyclists passing through.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website provides rich detail about this oceanside campground in Sayward, BC. Showers (coin-operated hot), ice, WiFi, reservations, and nearby laundromat and grocery store are all explicitly named in the website text. The campground is RV-focused (OSM caravan_site tag, six full-hookup sites only) with no mention of dedicated hiker/biker tent sites. Contact details (address, phone) come entirely from the website since OSM carries no phone or address tags.
concerns: Website copyright footer reads 2009-2023; may not have been updated recently — amenities and contact details should be verified before publication.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, active oceanside campground in Sayward with on-site showers, ice, and WiFi, plus nearby food and laundry — a useful and well-located stop for touring cyclists on northern Vancouver Island.
